PROMPTING_SELF_EXPLANATION.name: Prompting self-explanation
PROMPTING_SELF_EXPLANATION.def: Asks the student to explain their own reasoning out loud.

PROMPTING_RELATED_CONCEPTS.name: Prompting related concepts
PROMPTING_RELATED_CONCEPTS.def: Asks the student to connect this to something they already know.

REVOICING.name: Revoicing
REVOICING.def: Restates what the student said in different words, keeping their idea at the centre.

PROMPTING_NEXT_STEP.name: Prompting next step
PROMPTING_NEXT_STEP.def: Asks the student to take the next step themselves, instead of being told what it is.

PROMPTING_CORRECTION.name: Prompting correction
PROMPTING_CORRECTION.def: Points the student back at their own mistake to fix, without showing the right way.

GIVING_HINT.name: Giving a hint
GIVING_HINT.def: Nudges toward the answer while leaving the work to the student.

GIVING_EXAMPLE.name: Giving an example
GIVING_EXAMPLE.def: Offers a parallel case for the student to reason from.

EXPLAINING_CONCEPTUAL.name: Explaining a concept
EXPLAINING_CONCEPTUAL.def: Explains why something works, not just how to do it.

EXPLAINING_PROCEDURAL.name: Explaining a procedure
EXPLAINING_PROCEDURAL.def: Walks through the steps of how something is done.

STRATEGIZING.name: Strategizing
STRATEGIZING.def: Sets out the plan or structure for tackling the problem.

PROBING_UNDERSTAND.name: Probing understanding
PROBING_UNDERSTAND.def: Checks what the student currently understands.

PROBING_PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE.name: Probing prior knowledge
PROBING_PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE.def: Checks what the student already knew coming in.

FEEDBACK_CORRECT.name: Feedback: correct
FEEDBACK_CORRECT.def: Confirms the student's answer is right.

FEEDBACK_INCORRECT.name: Feedback: incorrect
FEEDBACK_INCORRECT.def: Signals the answer isn't right, without necessarily supplying the right one.

FEEDBACK_NEUTRAL.name: Feedback: neutral
FEEDBACK_NEUTRAL.def: Acknowledges the answer without marking it right or wrong.

CORRECTING_OWN_ERROR.name: Correcting own error
CORRECTING_OWN_ERROR.def: The tutor catches and repairs their own mistake.

ASKING_TO_CLARIFY_CONTEXT.name: Asking to clarify context
ASKING_TO_CLARIFY_CONTEXT.def: Asks what the student is looking at or working on.

VALIDATING_FEELING.name: Validating feeling
VALIDATING_FEELING.def: Names and accepts how the student is feeling.

BUILDING_RAPPORT.name: Building rapport
BUILDING_RAPPORT.def: Builds the relationship rather than working on the maths.

ENCOURAGING.name: Encouraging
ENCOURAGING.def: Urges the student to keep going.

PRAISING_PROCESS.name: Praising process
PRAISING_PROCESS.def: Praises effort or strategy — what the student did.

PRAISING_OUTCOME.name: Praising outcome
PRAISING_OUTCOME.def: Praises the result the student reached.

PRAISING_TRAITS.name: Praising traits
PRAISING_TRAITS.def: Praises the student as a person ('you're so clever').

ASKING_FEELING.name: Asking about feeling
ASKING_FEELING.def: Asks how the student is doing.

MANAGING.name: Managing the session
MANAGING.def: Handles the running of the session itself.

TECHNICAL_ISSUES.name: Technical issues
TECHNICAL_ISSUES.def: Deals with the platform rather than the maths.
